# Model vs baseline on the 2025 test set (generated by src/eval/summarize.py; do not edit by hand)

Test = 2025-01-01 UTC onward; all baselines fit on data before 2025 only. CIs: 90% bootstrap (AAR: whole days resampled; delay: flights resampled). Negative RMSE change = model better.
